semanticSynthesis.description: Graphify semantic synthesis (LLM-powered community labeling, semantic summaries, narrative GRAPH_REPORT sections) is retained but inactive. The Graphify binary and scheduler config are preserved. Semantic synthesis is NOT part of the CBM migration scope — CBM provides structural navigation only, not semantic summarization.
semanticSynthesis.retentionReason: Graphify semantic synthesis is a distinct capability from structural code indexing. It may be separately reactivated under its own approved task if the value justifies it.
semanticSynthesis.currentState: Inactive. Last semantic synthesis output: 2026-07-14 (stale). Community labels in current graphify-out are placeholders (Community 0, Community 1) — no LLM labeling present in current Workbench or Brain outputs.
semanticSynthesis.reactivationCondition: Separate approved task with explicit brain-runtime authorization. Reactivation of semantic synthesis does not require Graphify structural indexing to also resume.
semanticSynthesis.note: CBM does not replace semantic synthesis. If semantic synthesis value is proven, it may coexist with CBM as a scheduled supplemental step.

historicalIndexes.description: Existing graphify-out artifacts (graph.json, GRAPH_REPORT.md, manifest.json) are non-authoritative. They were built from stale commits. They must not be used as current architecture truth. Their SHA-256 checksums are retained in the freeze manifest for integrity verification.
